decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement builds directly on the firm's pharmacy supplement know-how, so the firm can read its results and refine it, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some risk.

As an extension of the established Trivital line, the joint product benefits from strong related knowledge in formulation, regulation and pharmacy marketing, which makes improvement more likely than withdrawal.

The niche mushroom immune supplement got little visibility and was not observed after launch, and the firm holds little specific knowledge to improve it, so its resources are better used in the core business.

Although distant from the supplement offer, the OTC triptan draws on the firm's core pharmaceutical development, manufacturing and regulatory capabilities, fits its strategy of expanding consumer health, and the missing archive pages give no evidence against it.
